newsitem.title: USA: DSI expects fourth quarter loss.
newsitem.headline: DSI expects fourth quarter loss.

text.p: - Digital Solutions Inc said on Wednesday that it expects a fourth quarter loss for the period ended Sept. 30, of about $600,000 on more than $27 million in revenues.
Included in this, the employer organization and provider of human resources management services will take a one-time charge against 1996 earnings in excess of $200,000 for severance payments.

Net income for the year ended Sept. 30, 1996, will be about $200,000 compared to a $3.3 million loss reported for the like period last year. Revenues for the year will be about $101 million, or a 36 percent increase over fiscal 1995.
In its initiative to improve its profit performance in 1997, DSI has reduced its staff by 12 percent and has replaced the entire management team in its Jackson, Miss. office.

Additionally, the company has signed a letter of intent to acquire the assets of a Texas PEO company. The acquisition will add approximately $15 million to DSI's revenues. The acquisition is subject to due diligence and negotiation and execution of a final agreement. Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
